name: Repos
description: All your projects' repositories at a glance: branch, uncommitted changes, ahead/behind and last fetch, with fetch/pull/push.

tools.description: Every repository in the user's workspaces at a glance, as the Repos view shows it: branch and upstream, commits to push and to pull, changed (uncommitted) files, when it was last fetched, and its path. attention: true lists only those with something to do. Answers 'is everything pushed?', 'what is uncommitted?', 'which branch is X on?'. Read only; to-pull counts are as of the last fetch (the fetch tool updates them).

repo.description: Only repositories whose name contains this (or this path)

attention.description: Only repositories with changes, commits to push or pull, no upstream, or an error

tools.description: A repository's newest commits (hash, how long ago, author, subject, branches and tags), the ones waiting to be pulled first, each marked to push or to pull. Read only.

repo.description: The repository's name or path, as the status tool lists it

tools.description: Fetch one repository from its remotes (git fetch --all --prune), or every repository like the Repos view's Fetch all repos, and say its state after. Only fetches: it never pulls, merges or pushes (the user does that from the Repos or Git view). Asks the user first.

repo.description: The repository's name or path; leave out to fetch all
